node_definition.done_when: A new tests/test_an_oversize_node_reaches_a_reserved_lane.py shows: a node whose estimated context exceeds the local window, declaring no hardest tier, is offered codex with the note 'offered because no open lane fits the node's context'; the same node within the local window is not offered codex; an oversize node is still refused when codex's window reading is at or above its ceiling; an oversize node is not offered a reserved lane whose own window it also exceeds; and an oversize node whose unreserved lane is excluded for a reason other than context-fit (availability, for example) gets no waiver. The decision is made in candidates() in reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py over the whole set. On the waiver path the reserved candidate's own context fit is computed (today _fit runs only for a candidate with no reasons), and the waiver is carried on a new Candidate note field in reckon/crew/picker/types.py, never in reasons, which pick() in reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py reads as exclusions. Carried review findings: the three read-back findings of 27 October (context fit on the waiver path, the context-fit-only clause tested, pick() not _pick). The test files importing each edited module add no failures against the base revision, at base and head; ruff check and ruff format --check pass on the changed paths. The coordinator runs the full importer arms.
